confirmation.reason: The primary one-pass candidate scored 0.064453125 against Hero 1, below the required score greater than 0.5.

findings: Hero 1 remains the strongest tested checkpoint: 90.8203125 percent against raw BT4 on this development allocation.
The epoch candidate scored 60.3515625 percent against raw BT4 but only 6.4453125 percent against Hero 1. Its raw-BT4 interval includes 50 percent; do not claim confirmed improvement over raw BT4.

Eight-pass refinement scored 33.984375 percent head-to-head against one-pass, with a marginal pair-aware 95 percent interval of 21.9803401085 to 45.9884098915 percent. This is a descriptive development comparison, not a simultaneous matrix-wide confirmation claim.

The native policy-only ablation scored 59.5703125 percent against raw BT4 and 5.6640625 percent against Hero 1. Similar point estimates to one-pass DFM do not establish equivalence or isolate a causal training effect.
All 2112 smoke and development games completed without policy faults, incomplete legal coverage, or ply-cap draws.
The full-epoch training recipe and Hero 1 differ in more than training duration; these matches alone do not identify the cause of the regression.

opening_quality.finding: Exact initial 12-ply action histories overlap with training for 2 of 128 development openings and 33 of 1024 reserved confirmation openings.
opening_quality.impact: Familiar starting histories are possible. This does not establish full-game leakage or contamination of newly played continuations; nonmatches do not prove source-game disjointness.
opening_quality.remediation: Keep these results descriptive. Establish full source-game provenance or use a new source-game-disjoint opening pool before any future held-out confirmation claim. Preserve this frozen allocation and all negative results.

representation_strength_threshold_propos.criterion: A paired 95 percent lower confidence bound above -50 relative logistic Elo versus Hero 1, at a matched one-pass inference budget, with zero faults, complete legal coverage, and at most 5 percent cap draws.
representation_strength_threshold_propos.rationale: Hero 1 substantially outperformed raw BT4, so merely beating raw BT4 would admit much weaker representations. A 50-Elo tolerance permits modest strength differences without admitting the observed large regression.
representation_strength_threshold_propos.required_before_use: Agree and freeze this proposed gate, a source-game-disjoint opening pool, fixed sample sizes, and multiplicity handling before inspecting architecture candidates. Report measured latency as well as network evaluations.

recommended_next_step: Design a bounded diagnostic of checkpoint trajectories and training-recipe differences before more training or architecture sweeps. No additional GPU runs are launched by this recommendation.
